elaine_sales: New POC ask from a regulated payments shop. Needs streaming + function calls that output NDJSON (strict schema), SSO (SAML), CMK, and a pilot price. Can eng/sec/ops confirm quick checklist?

ryan_eng: Quick Qs: inline vs async function results? ordering per conversation required? peak qps/tokens?

elaine_sales: Inline preferred for decisions, async ok for batch. Must preserve per-conversation order. Estimate 45 qps peak, ~120k tokens/day.

ryan_eng: Approach: SSE with per-session affinity to keep ordering. Emit event types: response_chunk, function_call, function_result. Stamp "schema_version" on each function event. Client validates NDJSON lines on arrival. Small JS snippet: const es = new EventSource(url); es.onmessage = e => JSON.parse(e.data);

sam_sec: SAML + SCIM supported. For CMK use AWS/GCP KMS on Dedicated/Private; Hosted CMK via enterprise contract. Recommend short-lived API tokens and IP allowlist. On-prem HSM escalates and adds lead time.

ivy_ops: For ordering guarantee pick Dedicated with session pinning. Enable token-level cost breakdown and SIEM export. We'll queue a Dedicated sizing job when they commit. Also suggest a quantized fallback for cost spikes.

elaine_sales: Pricing ballpark for procurement: 1 month pilot, 120k tokens/day streaming + func calls. Any numbers?

ryan_eng: Ballpark hosted: ~$0.0008/token -> 120k*30=3.6M tokens ~= $2.9k/mo (model-dependent). Dedicated reserved pool for ordering/SLA: expect a monthly commit starting ~$16k-22k depending on region. I can run a model-mix sim with a quantized variant if you want exact figures.

deploy-bot: [task] Dedicated pool sizing job queued id ds-9147.

elaine_sales: Great, please drop a 1-page checklist + sample NDJSON schema and I'll attach to the SAQ reply. Thanks! :pray:
